columns.name: metadata
columns.description: What the source stated about this row that the standard does not model, carried in the source's own vocabulary and read by no rule.

rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, block_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.blocks
WHERE stop_tick < start_tick

rules.message: two blocks of one session overlap, so a trial falls in both
rules.sql:
SELECT a.session_id, a.block_id, b.block_id AS other
FROM dynamic_foraging.blocks AS a
JOIN dynamic_foraging.blocks AS b ON a.session_id = b.session_id
  AND a.block_id < b.block_id
WHERE a.start_tick <= b.stop_tick
  AND b.start_tick <= a.stop_tick

rules.message: a trial names a block whose interval does not contain it
rules.sql:
SELECT t.session_id, t.trial_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.trials AS t
JOIN dynamic_foraging.blocks AS b ON b.session_id = t.session_id
  AND b.block_id = t.block_id
JOIN core.intervals AS c ON c.session_id = t.session_id
  AND c.interval_id = t.trial_id
WHERE c.start_tick < b.start_tick
  OR c.stop_tick > b.stop_tick

rules.message: a minimum exceeds its maximum, so nothing can be drawn from the range
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.sessions
WHERE block_min > block_max
  OR delay_min > delay_max
  OR iti_min > iti_max

rules.message: a curriculum stage is named with no curriculum to place it in
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.sessions
WHERE auto_train_stage IS NOT NULL
  AND auto_train_curriculum_name IS NULL

columns.name: session_id

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: The trial, and the interval it occupies in core.

columns.name: block_id
columns.description: The block this trial falls in. Blocks are derived from where the reward probabilities change, since the source records no boundary.

columns.name: animal_response
columns.description: Which way the animal responded. The source emits 0, 1 and 2; the writer decodes them, because a code whose key is not in the packet leaves no rule, query or reader able to tell one response from another.

columns.name: rewarded_history_right

columns.name: bait_right

columns.name: reward_probability_right

columns.description: The draw the left outcome was decided by, so a reanalysis can reproduce it.

columns.name: reward_random_number_right

columns.description: Lickspout position.

rules.message: a trial's session is not the session of the interval it occupies
rules.sql:
SELECT t.session_id, t.trial_id, c.session_id AS interval_session_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.trials AS t
JOIN core.intervals AS c ON c.interval_id = t.trial_id
WHERE c.session_id <> t.session_id

rules.message: the go cue precedes the delay it is supposed to follow
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, trial_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.trials
WHERE delay_start_tick IS NOT NULL
  AND go_cue_start_tick IS NOT NULL
  AND go_cue_start_tick < delay_start_tick

rules.message: the outcome is recorded before the go cue
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, trial_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.trials
WHERE reward_outcome_tick IS NOT NULL
  AND go_cue_start_tick IS NOT NULL
  AND reward_outcome_tick < go_cue_start_tick

SELECT session_id, trial_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.trials
WHERE NOT reward_probability_left BETWEEN 0 AND 1
  OR NOT reward_probability_right BETWEEN 0 AND 1

rules.message: a reward random number falls outside 0-1, so the outcome cannot be reproduced
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, trial_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.trials
WHERE NOT reward_random_number_left BETWEEN 0 AND 1
  OR NOT reward_random_number_right BETWEEN 0 AND 1

rules.message: a port paid out where nothing was baited
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, trial_id
FROM dynamic_foraging.trials
WHERE (rewarded_history_left AND NOT bait_left)
  OR (rewarded_history_right AND NOT bait_right)

rules.message: a block's trials disagree about the reward probabilities, so the block is not one
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, block_id
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, block_id, COUNT(DISTINCT reward_probability_left) AS l,
    COUNT(DISTINCT reward_probability_right) AS r
  FROM dynamic_foraging.trials
  WHERE block_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY session_id, block_id
) AS derived_1
WHERE l > 1
  OR r > 1
